import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

tests = Path("tests/test_browser_hardening.py")
text = tests.read_text()

old = '''        with patch.object(daemon, "activate_project"), patch.object(daemon, "ensure_browser_running"), patch.object(daemon, "notify_receipt") as send:
            threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(2)]
'''
new = '''        with patch.object(daemon, "activate_project"), patch.object(daemon, "ensure_browser_running"), patch.object(daemon, "notify_receipts") as send:
            threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(2)]
'''

if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("concurrency mock block not found")

tests.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))

subprocess.run([
    "python3", "-m", "py_compile",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
], check=True)

subprocess.run(
    ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon", "tests.test_browser_hardening"],
    check=True,
)

subprocess.run(
    ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"],
    check=True,
)

subprocess.run([
    "git", "add",
    "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
    "src/do_again/browser/__init__.py",
    "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    "tests/test_browser.py",
    "tests/test_daemon.py",
    "tests/test_browser_hardening.py",
], check=True)

subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Batch browser receipt notifications"], check=True)

push = subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"])
if push.returncode != 0:
    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "origin", "main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "rebase", "origin/main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run([
        "python3", "-m", "py_compile",
        "src/do_again/browser/runtime.py",
        "src/do_again/service/daemon.py",
    ], check=True)
    subprocess.run(
        ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_browser", "tests.test_daemon", "tests.test_browser_hardening"],
        check=True,
    )
    subprocess.run(
        ["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"],
        check=True,
    )
    subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)

print("HEAD=" + subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("STATUS=")
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--short"], text=True))
